title.narrative: From Streets to Stories: Youth in Focus

description.narrative: Our initiative centres around a one-time print edition of a youth-led newspaper in informal settlements Mukuru and Mathare, Nairobi. This endeavour serves as a dual purpose, firstly, contributing to youth empowerment and secondly, cultural exchange, thus we are seeking funding to support this engagement activity. In addition, we would like to foster a cultural understanding and connection with Danish high school students, by using the newspaper as learning-material. The entire initiative is youth-led, ensuring that young individuals themselves are at the forefront of shaping their narratives and experiences. By facilitating their ability to tell their own stories and by promoting cultural exchange, we are empowering them to be both storytellers and ambassadors of change.
